Each published service delivery method is built from a collection of shared components, each of which has its own development and release cycles. The included release information provides a mechanism for determining what version of each of the included components is included in this publication.

Information on the method sponsors and stewards is located on the welcome page under the key contacts section. Where available a list of any additional key contacts will also be linked there. The individual release information pages contain a list of the contributors for each of the various components that make up a given method build.

Click here to view the release information with the most relevant details about what's new for this publication.

For a listing of other available methods and additional contact information please visit the Methods Navigator.
